store.description: Counter-Strike 1.6 as a browser port (Global Strike). Pick a side, buy your kit and take the bomb site — the classic round-based shooter without Steam or an install.
features: Classic CS 1.6 maps, weapons and round rules
WASD + mouse, click to lock the pointer and fire
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
